coingecko_dominance.reason: Public API limited to 365 days; historical global market cap requires paid Pro subscription and lacks point-in-time archive covering the 2021-2026 cohort. Excluded per Section 3.1 without blocking core.

binance_btcdom.reason: Binance BTCDOM is a relative price strength index, not actual global market cap dominance. Surrogate definition rejected per Section 3.1.

crypto_binance_orderbook_snapshot_1h.reason: Order book history only starts in 2023, insufficient for 2021-2026 timeline; out of scope for daily macro-regime forecast.

deribit_options.reason: Deribit options history lacks live tail and approved reader in [I1]; excluded per Section 3.1.

fear_and_greed.reason: Supplemental external indicator not required for core V1.2 deliverables; default OFF.

funding_rate_raw_rest.reason: No separate canonical reader in [I1]; funding proxy derived from perp klines/metrics where available.
